details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:998-1005 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root and template copies of `pr_merge_status_guard.py` are not byte-identical, causing the template parity tests to fail.
  WHY: The parity test fails and blocks the required CI check; the root copy is missing logic present in the template copy.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:260-275 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The root guard is out of sync with its workflow template and lacks redirect-handling and shell-assignment parsing improvements.
  WHY: Tests import the outdated root guard, contributing to five failures in `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and failing the required aggregate lint check.
- .claude/settings.json:86-95 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root and template copies of `.claude/settings.json` may differ despite having the same line count.
  WHY: The byte-identity assertion checks these files, contributing to the CI failures and blocked required check.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:22-26, 31-39, 998-1004 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The checkout lacks `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` and `.claude/settings.json`, which the tests load directly.
  WHY: Test collection raises when `_load_guard()` executes, and the parity tests also read the absent root assets, leaving the required aggregate CI check failing.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:line 105 in unblock_latest_wait() | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Wait-marker extraction does not strip trailing carriage returns from CRLF comment lines.
  WHY: The marker regex fails to match a line ending in `\r`, so active fix-up wait markers are ignored and duplicate fix-ups can be filed.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:lines 495-498 in missing_project_markers | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Project-marker reconciliation does not strip trailing carriage returns from CRLF comment lines.
  WHY: The marker suffix check fails against a line ending in `\r`, so unblock verdict markers fail to reconcile onto tracking issues.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 15779-15783 in handle_unblock_judge_project_hooks() | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Fix-up request parsing does not strip trailing carriage returns from CRLF comment lines.
  WHY: The request regex fails to match, so fix-up requests on tracking issues are silently ignored and never scheduled into the active wave.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:upsert(), the reconciliation block after load_entry_comments that checks `matches[-1]["id"] == created_comment_id` followed by patch-oldest/delete-newer and a silent else path | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Concurrent same-key upserts can let an older proposal overwrite the canonical operator-step comment after a newer proposal has been consolidated.
  WHY: A writer can reconcile from a stale comment listing and patch the canonical comment with older content, leaving outdated instructions until the next upsert.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:lines 177-240 in upsert() and .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:725-735, .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:30-35 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The script performs an un-serialized whole-body read-modify-write of the shared issue body.
  WHY: Concurrent activation-verify, unblock-judge, or poller runs can overwrite the issue body with only their own entries, silently destroying operator steps written by another run.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 15923-15925; scripts/unblock_scan.py:lines 204-219 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The scan truncates combined search results and failed-project IDs to the numerically smallest 30 before fetching GraphQL details.
  WHY: A failed project outside that slice has no trusted state-comment timestamp and is skipped as too recent, so it may never be judged.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:lines 308-312; scripts/unblock_ledger.py:lines 303-314 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The evidence normalizer deletes every sequence of three or more digits, including meaningful error values.
  WHY: Distinct errors such as 404 and 500 normalize to the same text, allowing the ledger's used-verdict filter to suppress a verdict for a different issue.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_run_ops() close branch, lines after the `if [ "${ops_failed}" = "true" ]` guard that issues `continue` | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: When a close operation is skipped after a prior failure, `close_failed` is not set to `true`.
  WHY: The current outer loop guard prevents the label from being added, but the secondary `close_failed` guard would be wrong if that outer guard changed.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_run_ops() create_issue branch, the wait-marker failure path that closes the orphan fix-up | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: If posting the wait marker fails and closing the orphan fix-up also fails, no further action is taken.
  WHY: The verdict round is already consumed, so a later judge run may skip the item while the orphan fix-up remains open indefinitely.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A failed scope edit cannot be followed by /approved"
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_actions.py plan() override_guard branch or unblock_judge.sh unblock_run_ops()
  confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The action planner emits edit_files_touched before _approve(); unblock_run_ops skips non-close/telegram ops after ops_failed is set by a failed edit_files_touched, so the requirement is satisfied by existing sequential ops execution rather than explicit precondition checking.
- requirement: "Operator steps use one keyed comment per source instead of a shared issue-body read-modify-write, so concurrent activation, poller and unblock runs cannot overwrite each other or require a workflow concurrency group that drops pending runs"
  expected_change_site: scripts/operator_step_issue.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/operator_step_issue.py` stores entries as sections inside the single issue body via `render_body()` and PATCH `repos/{repo}/issues/{number} -f body={body}`; no per-source comment creation or comment-based entry reconciliation exists in `scripts/operator_step_issue.py`.
- requirement: "Phase 7 of docs/plans/replace-claude-sessions-with-cli-engine-plan.md: the unblock judge (Q10-Q13 A)" and the PR description lists deliverables including the scan, judge, hard limits, acting, hand-overs, and safety properties.
  expected_change_site: All files listed in the Phase 7 plan section of the PR description.
  confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: All listed deliverables are present in the diff. The scan (`run_unblock_scan` in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`), judge (`scripts/unblock_judge.sh`, `.github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml`), ledger (`scripts/unblock_ledger.py`), actions (`scripts/unblock_actions.py`), prompt (`prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt`), hand-overs (`review_autofix.yml`, `workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh`, `orchestrate_poll_process.sh`), safety (model credentials stripped, read-only Claude profile, keyed operator-step comments), and tests (`tests/test_unblock_judge.py`, `tests/test_unblock_scan.py`) are all implemented.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_run_ops() close branch, lines after the `if [ "${ops_failed}" = "true" ]` guard that issues `continue` | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the close operation is skipped because a prior operation already set ops_failed="true", the internal guard executes `continue` without first setting `close_failed="true"`.
  WHY: The subsequent add_labels(ai:unblock-closed) operation runs with close_failed still "false", but the outer loop guard currently prevents the label from being added; the close_failed guard is a secondary defense that would be wrong if the outer loop guard changed.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:upsert(), the reconciliation block after load_entry_comments that checks `matches[-1]["id"] == created_comment_id` followed by patch-oldest/delete-newer and a silent else path | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the comment listing has not yet included the newly created comment, the silent else path skips reconciliation; concurrent writers can then reconcile comments in an order that overwrites fresher content.
  WHY: The operator-step issue can show outdated instructions until the next upsert.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_run_ops() create_issue branch, the wait-marker failure path that closes the orphan fix-up | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If posting the wait marker fails and closing the orphan fix-up also fails, the failure is logged but no further action is taken.
  WHY: The verdict round is already consumed, so a later judge run may skip the item and the orphan fix-up may remain open indefinitely.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:tests-hooks-and-orchestrator job, the test_template_copies_are_identical test at tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:998-1004 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` and workflow template copy are not byte-identical; the root guard is smaller.
  WHY: Five tests fail in `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, causing the required CI check to fail and blocking the PR from merging.
- .claude/settings.json:Lines 86-95 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root and template `.claude/settings.json` files may differ despite having the same line count.
  WHY: The byte-identity assertion checks these files and contributes to the five CI failures and blocked required check.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "A failed scope edit cannot be followed by /approved" (PR description Hard limits section)
  Expected change site: scripts/unblock_actions.py plan() override_guard branch or unblock_judge.sh unblock_run_ops()
  Evidence of absence: The action planner emits edit_files_touched before _approve(), but unblock_run_ops correctly skips non-close/telegram ops after ops_failed is set by a failed edit_files_touched. The outer loop guard already prevents the approve chain from running. This requirement is satisfied by the existing sequential ops execution model, not by explicit precondition checking.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
